graphs.reference_reactive_expanded_command: A-selective and global request gates at actual full-power A reference upper+delivery delay; B-selective gate at actual full-power B reference upper+delay. Guard requiring observed prior failure is relaxed. Exact fault identity is privileged.
graphs.early_fit_expanded_command: Every request gate at eight-pair capture time (80ms)+delivery delay. Failure-feedback guard is relaxed; exact fault is privileged. All physical zero times must preserve actual full-power reference events.

actions: At most one initial selective A (50ms), one retry A (450ms), one selective B (450ms), one global relay (50ms); selective commands share FIFO; relay independent and irreversible. Requests on 10ms grid from declared gate through horizon.

finite_reduction.state: first power-zero ticks (a,b); later commands have no physical effect
finite_reduction.a_less_b: A must stop selectively. Replace later B shutdown by global at b: identical trajectory, no longer service cost. Earliest A effect is gate_A+50ms for no fault, gate_A+500ms for drop_first; persistent is impossible in this form.
finite_reduction.b_less_a: B must stop selectively; replace later A shutdown by global at a. Need b>=gate_B+450ms and a>=gate_A+50ms.
finite_reduction.completeness: Enumerate all integer effect pairs on the declared grid satisfying one normal form; per-rotor feasible effect sets exactly prune pairs using interval scoring and continuity. Replacing a later shutdown by global cannot affect an already-zero rotor. This is a complete search of the named expanded graph, not unrestricted robot control.

witnesses: One command-feasible native witness for each oracle-feasible case and graph; separately reconstruct physical integration and event scoring. Witnesses are analysis artifacts, not causal policy executions or training labels.
containment: Check all 180 retained and 360 new causal trajectories preserve full-power references and satisfy request gates plus native device services. They are subsets of their named expanded graph. Oracle-infeasible therefore excludes TRUE for those controller subsets; an oracle-feasible case does not prove a causal policy can attain it.
excluded: pre-reference physical shutdown and endogenous reference manipulation; unknown/noisy response families; chemical outcomes; multi-step contact actions; physical real-time guarantees
retry_order_rule: Retry exists only after an initial A request, and its request time is at or after initial ACK; observed failure wait is relaxed in the oracle only.
